_comment: Orchestrator-owned. Branch name -> the ONLY paths that branch may touch. A PR touching anything else fails CI even if the change is correct. Frozen paths fail for every worker branch without exception (quarantine trigger Q1). Structure per AMENDMENT 01 §3.
_frontend_note: app/(ui)/** is deliberately absent. The frontend is ceded to a human collaborator outside AO. Branches that do not match ^W\d{2}[a-c]?- skip this check entirely, so the collaborator is unblocked without an entry here. The ui-metric-literal rule in check-forbidden.mjs still applies to their commits — that gate crosses the boundary and is not negotiable.
_precedence_note: The frozen check runs BEFORE the scope check, so a frozen path is denied even when it falls inside the requesting worker's own glob. data/MANIFEST matches W02's data/** and is denied to W02 for exactly that reason — the eval trigger must not sit inside the glob of the one worker with a motive to regenerate the dataset. Verified by the ownership-matcher tests in tools/selftest.mjs.
_truth_json_note: data/truth.json is deliberately NOT frozen. W02 must create it, and freezing it would make its own author unable to write it. It is protected differently and more strongly: after `pnpm freeze` its bytes are hashed into data/MANIFEST, so any later edit fails the manifest gate (Q7). Before the freeze there is nothing to protect. Reading it is separately walled off — the firewall-truth rule bans any reference to truth.json under engine/, llm/, app/ or components/, proven end-to-end in tools/selftest.mjs.

frozen_exceptions._comment: W01 builds lib/types.ts once, inside the window, then it freezes. This is the only exemption and it exists for exactly one branch. eval/thresholds.json is NOT exempted for W03 — it is authored at Wave 0 precisely so the eval gate keys on a file no worker can remove (AMENDMENT 01 §6).
